title: The full tests.py fails test_kbpublic when KB_NO_PUBLISH_HOOK or KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER is set, so the review story's done fails in the manager session and in a runner
goal: tests.py gives every test the same result whether or not the session exported KB_NO_PUBLISH_HOOK (the runbook tells the manager session to) or KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER (autopilot.child_env sets it in every runner): conftest clears both before any test, and the tests that need them set them with monkeypatch, so a sprint's review story, whose checks run the full tests.py from the manager's tick, can pass
notes: Theme: guard and environment contradictions (analysis of the 2026-10-02..04 co-development, mac-eighth). Evidence: kb/_self/backlog.md:312 tells the manager session to export KB_NO_PUBLISH_HOOK=1; kbpublic.py:724 makes publish --hook do nothing with it or KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER; test_kbpublic.py:236 calls the hook without clearing either; conftest.py:44-54 clears only KB_ROOTS and the git location variables; bl_base.REVIEW_CHECKS runs the full tests.py; reproduced 2026-10-04: the test fails with either variable and passes without. mac-fourth's review done failed 5 test_kbpublic tests this way (ST-vyosyurg, ST-bbtmua53). The review story's done is the tick's step 3, so a sprint could never close unattended.
